scope: Isolated Edge, generated fixtures and mock AI. Optional saved public paper/image are inspected locally, not bundled. No user profile or real-model accuracy test.

results.name: Numbered captions classify image tables; thumbnail layout is excluded while native data and small icons remain correct
Exact same-page references and blank named anchors identify otherwise uncaptioned images
Adjacent and accessible captions retain supplementary/Chinese names; distinct panels sharing a caption survive
Broad multi-figure containers and linked prose references do not mislabel unrelated images
Paper-only inventory drops ordinary photos, banners and unlabeled canvases but keeps semantic charts and captions
Loaded thumbnails persist as previews, never as analysis-ready originals; image tables can be selected in one click
Batch loading fetches full-size linked originals with generic MIME, keeps selection/order and preserves 2500-pixel detail
Missing MIME originals load too; explicit Q&A transmits selected full-resolution images, numbered captions and native table text
Original resize limit differs from screenshot limit without upscaling
Missing/misleading MIME never accepts HTML, corrupt images or oversized responses
Original downloads use only stored source URLs and enforce source permissions before fetching
Image-table overview and controls fit 390, 620 and 1440 pixel windows
No uncaught browser errors and no automatic AI requests
